ينتهكون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَهِكُونَ (yantahikūna) /jan.ta.hi.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# يُنْتَهَكُونَ (yuntahakūna) /jun.ta.ha.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
